modules.summary: Upright torso on two legs with two free arms; walks. Lean the torso forward and add a tail for a raptor.
A horse-like body on four legs with an upright, torso-like neck carrying two arms and the head.
A legless, deep-bodied swimmer with pectoral and pelvic fins, a dorsal fin and a tail fin; lives in water.
Six sprawled legs on a low, wide body with chitin skin; runs a tripod gait.
Eight sprawled legs on a small front body and a big round abdomen, like a spider or a scorpion.
Four legs under a horizontal torso, a raised neck and a tail; walks and trots.
Legless snake body with a long tail and scales; slithers with a wave down the spine.
Two legs under a horizontal body, wings for forelimbs, a long neck and tail; for bats and wyverns.
A jointed antenna that sways on springs: thread-like, clubbed or feathery; side "both" for a pair.

shape.description: "thread" plain, "club" thickened at the tip (a butterfly), "feather" combed (a moth)

curve.description: Degrees it curves back at rest

color.description: Colour: a palette name or a colour

modules.summary: Overlapping bands of armour across an area of the body, like an armadillo or a pangolin.

overlap.description: How much each band overlaps the next

scales.description: Break the bands into scales, like a pangolin

color.description: Armour colour: a palette name or a colour

modules.summary: A horny beak in two halves over the snout, upper on the head and lower on the jaw, for birds and griffins.

shape.description: "hooked" like an eagle, "straight" like a heron, "broad" like a duck

length.description: How far the beak runs on past the snout, relative to the snout

depth.description: How deep and heavy the beak is

color.description: Beak colour: a palette name or a colour

modules.summary: Leaf-shaped ear, upright or drooping; use side "both" for a pair.

thickness.description: Thickness as a share of the width: low is a flat leaf, 1 a round cone

curve.description: Degrees the ear bends; positive sweeps back toward the tail, negative forward

lean.description: Degrees the root tilts forward (+) or back (-)

droop.description: How much the ear flops outward and down, 0 upright to 1 hanging

color.description: Colour at the root: a palette name or a colour

modules.summary: Round eyeball with an iris and pupil, sized to the head, with eyelids that blink (or none).

scale.description: Eye size relative to the head: 1 is typical, 2 big, 0.5 small

size.description: Eyeball radius in torso lengths; when set it wins over `scale`

irisColor.description: Iris colour: a palette name or a colour

scleraColor.description: Colour of the eyeball around the iris

iris.description: Iris size as a share of the visible eye

bulge.description: How far the eye stands out of the skin

lids.description: Eyelids that blink; snakes, fish and insects have none

squint.description: How far the upper lid hangs over the eye at rest: 0 wide open, 1 a menacing squint

modules.summary: One fin standing on the midline of the back (or belly, at angle 180), like a shark's.

length.description: Length along the body at its base

shape.description: "triangle" like a shark, "sail" tall and straight, "rounded" like a carp

color.description: Fin colour: a palette name or a colour

modules.summary: A tail fin at the tail tip: forked like a shark, rounded like a carp, or flat like a whale.

upper.description: Share of the fin above the tail line

color.description: Fin colour: a palette name or a colour

modules.summary: Foot or hand of short toes, each tipped with a curved claw; set it as a limb's "foot".

clawLength.description: Claw length in torso lengths; 0 for none

clawWidth.description: Claw thickness relative to the toe

clawColor.description: Claw colour: a palette name or a colour

modules.summary: A hoof, single (a horse) or cloven (a goat or boar); set it as a leg's "foot".

cloven.description: Split into two toes, like a goat or a boar

size.description: Hoof size relative to the leg tip

height.description: How tall the hoof wall is

color.description: Hoof colour: a palette name or a colour

modules.summary: A broad column foot with blunt nails, for heavy creatures like elephants and trolls.

width.description: Foot width relative to the leg tip

nailColor.description: Nail colour: a palette name or a colour

modules.summary: A padded paw with toes and visible or hidden claws, like a dog or a big cat.

size.description: Paw size relative to the leg tip

claws.description: "hidden" like a cat at rest, "short" like a dog, "long" like a bear

padColor.description: Colour of the pads: a palette name or a colour

modules.summary: A bird-like foot: three long toes forward, one back, each with a hooked talon.

grip.description: How curled the toes are at rest

color.description: Scaly toe colour: a palette name or a colour

modules.summary: A fan of spines with skin between them around the neck, folded at rest and opened in display.

radius.description: Frill radius when open, in torso lengths

open.description: How open it is at rest

color.description: Membrane colour: a palette name or a colour

modules.summary: A grasping hand: fingers and an opposed thumb, with nails or claws; set it as "foot".

claws.description: Claw length in torso lengths; 0 for nails

clawColor.description: Claw or nail colour: a palette name or a colour

modules.summary: A crab or scorpion pincer: a heavy claw with one hinged finger that snaps shut.

color.description: Claw colour: a palette name or a colour

modules.summary: A cobra's hood: neck ribs that spread the skin into a flat shield in display.

width.description: Hood width when spread, in torso lengths

length.description: Share of the neck the hood covers

open.description: How spread it is at rest

markColor.description: Colour of the eye marks on the back of the hood

modules.summary: Tapered horn bent along an arc; use side "both" for a pair.

curve.description: Total bend in degrees; positive sweeps back toward the tail, negative forward; past 360 it coils

twist.description: Spiral in degrees along the horn, like a ram

lean.description: Degrees the root tilts forward (+) or back (-)

turn.description: Degrees the bend turns sideways: 90 curves toward the midline (mandibles), -90 away from it

aim.description: Which way the horn points, wherever it sits: forward (mandibles, a bull), up, out (away from the body), back (swept back) or down (tusks). It replaces lean and turn

color.description: Colour at the root: a palette name or a colour

modules.summary: A pair of hinged mandibles or fangs at the mouth corners that close with the bite.

shape.description: "mandible" like an ant, "fang" like a spider's chelicerae

color.description: Colour: a palette name or a colour

modules.summary: Leathery skin stretched between long finger bones, the body and the hind leg: bat and dragon wings.

span.description: Finger length relative to the arm: larger spreads a bigger wing

trailing.description: Where the trailing edge runs: to the nearest leg behind the wing, or to the body

scallop.description: How deeply the edge dips between fingers

color.description: Membrane colour: a palette name or a colour

modules.summary: A beetle's hard wing case (elytron): a shell that covers the same-side wing behind it and lifts in flight.

color.description: Case colour: a palette name or a colour

modules.summary: Overlapping flight feathers along the wing bones, for birds and griffins.

length.description: Feather length relative to the wing bones: larger makes a broader wing

tips.description: Wing tip: rounded, pointed (a falcon) or fingered (an eagle)

color.description: Feather colour: a palette name or a colour

modules.summary: A fin of thin rays with skin between them, on a fin limb (pectoral and pelvic fins).

width.description: Fin width relative to its length

color.description: Fin colour: a palette name or a colour

modules.summary: A thin, veined insect wing on a hinge, for flies, dragonflies, moths and bees.

shape.description: "narrow" like a dragonfly, "broad" like a moth, "round" like a beetle

width.description: Wing width relative to its length

color.description: Wing colour: a palette name or a colour

modules.summary: Upright bony plates along the back, in one row or two alternating rows like a stegosaur.

count.description: Plates in all; with alternate they take turns left and right

height.description: Height in torso lengths, as one number or a profile along the row

alternate.description: Two staggered rows, left and right

color.description: Plate colour: a palette name or a colour

modules.summary: Long sharp quills scattered over an area of the body, raised in display, like a porcupine.

lie.description: Degrees the quills lie back at rest

color.description: Quill colour: a palette name or a colour

modules.summary: A tall sail of skin stretched over long spines along the back, like a dimetrodon.

height.description: Height in torso lengths, as one number or a profile along the sail

color.description: Membrane colour: a palette name or a colour

modules.summary: A domed shell over an area of the body, divided into scutes, like a turtle or a tortoise.

dome.description: How domed: 0 flat, 1 a high tortoise shell

overhang.description: How far the rim reaches past the body

scutes.description: Plates on the shell; 0 for smooth

color.description: Shell colour: a palette name or a colour

seamColor.description: Colour of the seams between scutes

modules.summary: A row of conical spikes between two points, e.g. down the spine at angle 0.

count.description: Spikes in the row (in each row, with side "both")

height.description: Height in torso lengths, as one number or a profile along the row

curve.description: Degrees each spike sweeps back toward the tail

jitter.description: Irregular heights and angles, for jagged rows

color.description: Colour at the root: a palette name or a colour

modules.summary: Teeth standing in the gums along the mouth, sized to the head: incisors, fangs, then cheek teeth. The upper row moves with the head, the lower with the jaw.

scale.description: Tooth size relative to the head: 1 is typical, 2 big, 0.5 small

fangScale.description: Fang size relative to the head: 1 is typical, 2 sabre-like

spacing.description: Gap between neighbouring teeth as a share of a tooth’s width; 0 packs them tight

incisors.description: Small front teeth on each side before the fangs (not used when `count` is set)

fangs.description: Long fangs at the front of each row

count.description: Teeth per row on each side; without it, as many as `spacing` fits

length.description: Tooth length in torso lengths; when set it wins over `scale`

fangLength.description: Fang length in torso lengths; when set it wins over `fangScale`

color.description: A palette name such as "accent", or a colour such as "#2a1e14"

modules.summary: Wide, even rings of colour around the body and tail, like a coral snake or a lemur tail.

color.description: Band colour: a palette name or a colour

count.description: Bands from snout to tail tip

width.description: Band width as a share of the spacing

sharpness.description: How crisp the band edges are

modules.summary: Glowing spots or lines that light up in the dark and pulse slowly.

color.description: Glow colour: a palette name or a colour

shape.description: "spots" scattered over the skin, or "lines" of dots along the body

size.description: Spot radius or line width in torso lengths

density.description: Share of possible spots that glow

brightness.description: Emissive strength; 1 matches a lit surface

modules.summary: Paler belly blending into a darker back, as on most animals.

color.description: Belly colour: a palette name or a colour

height.description: Where the blend sits: -1 belly, 0 flank, 1 back

modules.summary: Dirt gathered in creases, on the feet and low on the body; adds roughness.

color.description: A palette name such as "accent", or a colour such as "#2a1e14"

feet.description: Dirt rising from the ground up the legs

modules.summary: Soft, cloudy blotches of a second colour that break up the outline.

color.description: A palette name such as "accent", or a colour such as "#2a1e14"

contrast.description: How sharp the blotch edges are

modules.summary: Leopard-like rosettes: broken rings of dark marks around a tinted centre.

color.description: Ring colour: a palette name or a colour

density.description: Share of possible rosettes that appear

broken.description: How broken each ring is into separate marks

modules.summary: Overlapping scales in staggered rows down the body: each one raised at its free rear edge, with darker gaps.

gapColor.description: Colour in the gaps between scales: a palette name or a colour

gap.description: How dark and wide the gaps are

modules.summary: Old healed scars: pale, raised streaks and claw rakes across the skin.

color.description: Scar colour: a palette name or a colour

count.description: About how many scars over the whole body

rake.description: Parallel cuts per scar: 3 or 4 read as claw marks

depth.description: How raised and creased the scars are

modules.summary: A wet, glossy coat of slime with drips and a faint tint.

color.description: Slime tint: a palette name or a colour

wetness.description: How glossy the skin gets (1 is mirror-wet)

drips.description: How many drips run down the flanks

tint.description: How much the slime colours the skin

modules.summary: Scattered round spots, from leopard rosettes to sparse blotches.

color.description: A palette name such as "accent", or a colour such as "#2a1e14"

density.description: Share of possible spots that appear

modules.summary: Bands running across the spine (or along it), with optional wobble.

color.description: A palette name such as "accent", or a colour such as "#2a1e14"

count.description: Stripes from snout to tail tip

width.description: Stripe width as a share of the spacing

direction.description: "across" the spine like a tiger, or "along" it

fade.description: How much stripes fade toward the belly

modules.summary: A row of pale suckers down the underside of tentacles (and any limb), each a raised rim round a dark cup.

color.description: Rim colour: a palette name or a colour

centerColor.description: Colour in the cup: a palette name or a colour

size.description: Sucker length as a share of the spacing

width.description: How far round the underside they reach, in radians either side

modules.summary: Branching veins under thin skin, darker or glowing.

color.description: Vein colour: a palette name or a colour

raised.description: How far the veins stand out

modules.summary: Raised bumps and warts, like a toad or a troll.

color.description: Wart colour: a palette name or a colour

density.description: Share of possible warts that appear

height.description: How far the warts stand out

modules.summary: Small quadrupeds leaping with both hind legs, then both front legs, like a rabbit or a weasel; the back flexes and stretches with each leap.

duty.description: Share of the cycle each foot is planted: one number, or [slowest, fastest] (default [0.35, 0.22])

flex.description: How much the spine flexes each bound

stepHeight.description: Foot lift as a share of hip height

stride.description: Stride length multiplier: one number, or [slowest, fastest]

modules.summary: Flapping flight: power strokes on the way down, wings folded on the way up.

bank.description: Most degrees it banks into a turn

modules.summary: Fast four-legged gait with a leading foreleg and a moment in the air, like a horse (transverse) or a cheetah (rotary); the back flexes each stride.

style.description: "transverse" like a horse (the forefeet land in the same order as the hind), "rotary" like a cheetah or a dog (in the opposite order)

duty.description: Share of the cycle each foot is planted: one number, or [slowest, fastest] (default [0.4, 0.22])

flex.description: How much the spine flexes each stride

stepHeight.description: Foot lift as a share of hip height

stride.description: Stride length multiplier: one number, or [slowest, fastest]

modules.summary: Soaring and gliding on spread wings between flaps.

sink.description: How fast it loses height while gliding

modules.summary: Hovering in place on fast figure-eight wingbeats, like an insect or a hummingbird.
Two-legged running with a moment in the air each stride, for raptors and runners: feet are down less as it speeds up, and the body leans in.

duty.description: Share of the cycle each foot is planted: one number, or [slowest, fastest] (default [0.45, 0.3])

stepHeight.description: Foot lift as a share of hip height

stride.description: Stride length multiplier: one number, or [slowest, fastest]

lean.description: Degrees the body leans forward at speed

modules.summary: Legless travelling wave down the spine; each segment follows the path of the one ahead.

amplitude.description: Sideways swing as a share of body length

modules.summary: Swims by beating long fins or flippers like wings, like a turtle or a penguin; it dives.
Swims at the surface by paddling its legs in circles under the hips, like a dog, a bear or a crocodile going slowly.
Swims with a body wave that grows toward the tail, like a fish, an eel, a sea serpent or a crocodile; it dives and steers in three dimensions.

amplitude.description: Tail-beat width as a share of body length; the beat comes faster as it narrows

modules.summary: Six-legged insect gait: two alternating tripods of feet.

duty.description: Share of the cycle each foot is planted: one number, or [slowest, fastest] across its speeds

stepHeight.description: Foot lift as a share of hip height

stride.description: Stride length multiplier: one number, or [slowest, fastest]

modules.summary: Faster four-legged gait: diagonal feet move together.

duty.description: Share of the cycle each foot is planted: one number, or [slowest, fastest] across its speeds

stepHeight.description: Foot lift as a share of hip height

stride.description: Stride length multiplier: one number, or [slowest, fastest]

modules.summary: Slow gait for any leg count: feet lift one after another, back to front.

duty.description: Share of the cycle each foot is planted; defaults by leg count: one number, or [slowest, fastest] across its speeds

stepHeight.description: Foot lift as a share of hip height

stride.description: Stride length multiplier: one number, or [slowest, fastest]

modules.summary: Lunges the head at a target and snaps the jaw shut; fires a bite-contact event.

reach.description: How far the neck may stretch, as a share of its reach

modules.summary: Threat display: opens frills and hoods, raises quills and sails. Needs a part that provides `display`.

duration.description: Seconds for a creature with 1 m hips; scales with size

modules.summary: Breathing, weight shifts, glances, tail swish and blinks while standing.

fidget.description: How often it shifts and looks around

modules.summary: Crouches, leaps to a target point (or ahead) over the ground and any height asked for, and lands on its legs, absorbing it; fires takeoff and land events.

power.description: How hard it springs, 0 to 1: how far it leaps unaimed, and at most

crouch.description: How deep it crouches first, 0 to 1

height.description: Least height in metres it clears above the ground in the middle of the leap (over an obstacle); 0 for a natural arc

modules.summary: Whips the tail or a tentacle at a target; fires a lash-contact event.
Turns eyes, head and neck toward a target within limits.

range.description: Degrees the head may turn from straight ahead

modules.summary: Snaps a pincer shut on a target; fires a pinch-contact event.
A low crouch, a leap at the target and a bite as it lands, the head meeting the target; fires takeoff, land and bite-contact events.

power.description: How hard it springs, 0 to 1: how far it can pounce

reach.description: How far the head lunges at the end, as a share of what the neck can reach

modules.summary: Raises the head and opens the jaw wide; fires a roar-peak event.

duration.description: Seconds for a creature with 1 m hips; scales with size

intensity.description: How wide the jaw opens and how far the head rises

modules.summary: Sea and river creatures: sharks and fish with dorsal and tail fins, finned eels and sea serpents, and low armoured walkers that swim, in countershaded blues, teals and greys.
Muscled furred mammals: wolves and big cats on paws, boars and bulls on hooves, bears on pads, with ears, fangs, now and then horns or tusks, in tawny, brown, grey or black coats.
Horned fiends and hellhounds: heavy shoulders, big curled or swept horns, fangs, spine rows, goat or slit pupils, blood reds and soot blacks.
Winged dragons and wyverns: four legs and a pair of wings or wings for arms, long curved necks and tails, horns, crests, fangs, scales, in ember, emerald, gold or soot.
Things that should not be: tentacled krakens, many-headed hounds, faces of tentacles and clusters of eyes, slimy veined skin with a cold glow, in bruise purples and deep blacks.
Six-legged beetles and ants: glossy chitin, a thorax and abdomen with a narrow waist, thin legs, horns or mandibles, dark or warning colours.
Scaled lizards, raptors and snakes: low sprawling bodies, long tails, wedge or snout heads, slit pupils, greens and browns.

Generic action-RPG numbers: health from mass, speed from legs and gaits, attack from teeth, horns and claws, one attack per head, defence from shells, plates, chitin, scales and spikes, perception from eyes and ears.

level.description: Multiplies health, attack and defence (unitless; 1 is a normal encounter)

hints.limbs.hand: a hand goes in "foot", whatever the limb: "foot": "hand.grasp" (or "hand.pincer")
hints.limbs.wings: wings are limbs of their own: { "id": "wing", "role": "wing" }
hints.skin.material:feathers: only wings have feathers: a wing limb with "membrane": "membrane.feather"
hints.limbs.role:pincer: pincers are hands: an arm with "foot": "hand.pincer"
hints.limbs.role:claw: claws are feet or hands: a leg or arm with "foot": "foot.claw"
hints.body.fins: paired fins are limbs ({ "role": "fin" }); a dorsal fin is the part "fin.dorsal" and a tail fin "fin.tail"
